description: This file defines the interface for rbusValue, a variant data type used in rbus communication. It includes type definitions, function prototypes for initializing, setting, getting, comparing, and converting rbusValue instances, as well as handling date/time structures and reference counting. It is part of a testing stub for rbus in a C project.
